subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should OpenClaw land answer-candidate Activity entries as a narrow Codex progress slice now, or fold this work into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but Activity UX placement and relation to the broader safe-progress/privacy contract are product-surface choices automation should not settle.

options.title: Port and land narrow slice
options.body: Rebase the PR onto the current Control UI layout and land answer-candidate Activity entries while keeping broader plan/item progress in the canonical issue.

options.title: Fold into broader progress work
options.body: Pause this PR and require a single design/implementation that covers final candidates together with the rest of native Codex progress visibility.

options.title: Close this direction
options.body: Decline answer-candidate Activity as a permanent surface and keep the broader issue focused on another UI representation.

recommendation.title: Port and land narrow slice
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR onto the current Control UI layout and land answer-candidate Activity entries while keeping broader plan/item progress in the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans both the Control UI layout refactor and Codex app-server projection paths implicated by the decision.
